## Purpose

Human-visible bookkeeping for the user-authorized formalization of a dependency-aware stabilization scope through canonical PWv2 Intake/prior-art reconciliation, Brainstorming and Definition preparation. This is NOT another defect diagnosis or a replacement for independently tracked issues.

W0–W7 are proposed dependency/qualification checkpoints, not accepted implementation Cards. Canonical workflow must validate them; necessary changes to wave ordering or repair boundaries must be surfaced.

## Boundaries

- No repair implementation, consumer-repository modification, live-workstream migration, issue closure, merge, PR #9 adoption or deployment is authorized.
- Preserve #23's existing structural producer/schema-parity and bounded reconciliation subject, and #20's official caller-scoped native readiness/configuration subject. No broader subject is inferred from reusable infrastructure or issue prose.
- Preserve every independently demonstrated invariant and acceptance requirement, both audit provenance chains and immutable Git evidence. No distinct issue is silently absorbed into #23/#26 or declared duplicate.
- #25's substantial formal Research prerequisite remains unresolved; importing audit summaries does not satisfy it.
- No premium, exact Brainstorm revision promotion, Definition acceptance or implementation permission is supplied by this tracker.
